name: EmporiumPowerScreen
label: Power
description: Live home power usage from an Emporia Vue monitor, with per-circuit ranking and a daily usage trend chart

settings.title: Email
settings.desc: The email address for your Emporia (emporiaenergy.com) account

settings.title: Password
settings.desc: Your Emporia account password. Used to authenticate; tokens are cached locally afterward

settings.desc: Default number of days shown in the usage trend chart (1-30)

settings.title: Enabled
settings.desc: Enable the Emporia Power screen integration
